Order-invariant cluster first-order logic on finite graphs of bounded degree

lax-977378·formalized by Fatemeh Ghasemi·registered·created 23 Nov 2026·GitHub @7c77d80·Lean v4.33.0 epoch · mathlib db584cd6d46c

      Abstract

      For a fixed finite unary vocabulary and a degree bound, the target is elimination of the auxiliary linear order from every order-invariant cluster first-order sentence. The graph domain may be empty. The concepts give the thesis's cluster syntax, ordinary order-free syntax, their satisfaction relation, and recursive comparison of outer contexts. The submission separates the ordered comparison lemma, the construction of orders from finitely many first-order tests, and the final finite disjunction. The proof-dependency information in the local build identifies which statements have been discharged.
